cheatsheet.term: I'm so sorry to hear that
cheatsheet.ex: I'm so sorry to hear about your job.
That must be really hard for you.
Whatever happens, I'm here for you.
Take your time, there's no rush.

cheatsheet.term: Is there anything I can do?
cheatsheet.ex: Is there anything I can do to help?
Sometimes you just need to vent.
Hang in there, it'll get better.
I'll check in on you tomorrow.

cards.q: Друг говорит, что его уволили. Лучший ответ:
options: I'm so sorry to hear that. How are you feeling?

cards.explain: Иногда человеку нужны уши, а не решения 👂

audio.text: I don't need advice right now. I just need someone to listen.
Thanks for checking in on me. It really means a lot.

cards.explain: It means a lot — это очень важно для меня 💛

cards.prompt: Это, должно быть, очень тяжело для тебя.

cards.pattern: Is there anything I can + verb?

cards.text: I'm so sorry to hear that. I'm here for you, okay?
cards.tr: Мне очень жаль это слышать. Я рядом, слышишь?

cards.text: That must be really hard. Take your time, there's no rush. Is there anything I can do to help?
cards.tr: Это, должно быть, очень тяжело. Не торопись, спешить некуда. Могу я чем-то помочь?

n1.say: Hey... sorry, I'm not in a great mood today.
n1.tr: Привет... извини, у меня сегодня не лучшее настроение.

choices.text: Hey, no need to apologize. Do you want to talk about it?

choices.feedback: Звучит резковато. Мягче: Do you want to talk about it?

n2.say: I didn't get the job I really wanted. I thought the interview went well.
n2.tr: Меня не взяли на работу, которую я очень хотел(а). Мне казалось, интервью прошло хорошо.

choices.text: I'm so sorry to hear that. That must be really disappointing.
Oh well, there are lots of other jobs.

n3.say: Yeah. I just feel like I keep failing.
n3.tr: Да. Мне кажется, что я постоянно проваливаюсь.

choices.text: I get it. But one rejection doesn't define you. You got the interview, and that counts.
That's a lot to carry. Do you want advice, or do you just need to vent?

n4.say: Honestly, I think I just needed to vent. Thanks for listening.
n4.tr: Честно, мне просто нужно было выговориться. Спасибо, что выслушал(а).

choices.text: Anytime. I'm here for you. Is there anything I can do this week?
Of course. Hang in there, okay? I'll check in on you tomorrow.

n5.say: That really means a lot. Maybe coffee on Saturday?
n5.tr: Это очень много для меня значит. Может, кофе в субботу?
